Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Deep Learning [IT_4442]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Compare the bias-variance tradeoff in machine learning. How do you balance the two when tuning        (5)  
  a model to achieve better generalization?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyze the differences between classification and regression in supervised learning. How do the      (5)  
  techniques used in each differ in terms of model evaluation?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Analyze the components of a deep feedforward network. How do the input, hidden, and output            (5)  
  layers work together to learn from data?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply the backpropagation algorithm to adjust weights in a neural network. How does the gradient      (5)  
  of the loss function guide the training process?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Apply data augmentation techniques to improve the generalization of a deep learning model. How        (5)  
  does augmentation help in preventing overfitting on limited datasets?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Apply regularization techniques such as L1 and L2 to prevent overfitting. How do they affect the      (5)  
  complexity of the model and its performance?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                Evaluate the importance of choosing an appropriate learning rate for neural network optimization.     (5)  
  How does the learning rate schedule affect model training and convergence?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  B)           Evaluate the role of activation functions in CNNs. How do they impact the learning ability of the     (5)  
  network during training?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  
  Page #1

5)                        Evaluate the impact of vanishing and exploding gradients in RNNs. How do these issues affect the     (5)  
  network's ability to learn long-term patterns?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  B)                Evaluate the significance of the input, forget, and output gates in LSTMs. How do they contribute to (5)  
  the network's ability to remember long-term dependencies?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"
